mapper.sql: close_id closeId,tenant_id tenantId,store_id storeId,business_date businessDate, zone_id zoneId,business_day_start businessDayStart,close_version closeVersion, correction_of_close_id correctionOfCloseId,correction_reason_sha256 correctionReasonSha256,state, snapshot_sha256 snapshotSha256,manifest_sha256 manifestSha256,idempotency_key idempotencyKey, request_sha256 requestSha256,creator_user_id creatorUserId,preflight_run preflightRun, record_version recordVersion,created_at createdAt,updated_at updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ops_daily_close WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId}
SELECT FROM ops_daily_close WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ops_daily_close WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(close_version),0)+1 FROM ops_daily_close WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND business_date=#{businessDate}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(run_no),0)+1 FROM ops_daily_close_preflight WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId}

SELECT snapshot_id snapshotId,close_id closeId,run_no runNo,currency,order_count orderCount, cancelled_order_count cancelledOrderCount,return_count returnCount,gross_minor grossMinor, discount_minor discountMinor,surcharge_minor surchargeMinor,receivable_minor receivableMinor, refund_minor refundMinor,cash_received_minor cashReceivedMinor,cash_refunded_minor cashRefundedMinor, electronic_received_minor electronicReceivedMinor,electronic_refunded_minor electronicRefundedMinor, unknown_payment_count unknownPaymentCount,unknown_refund_count unknownRefundCount, shift_difference_minor shiftDifferenceMinor,content_sha256 contentSha256,created_at createdAt FROM ops_daily_close_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId} ORDER BY run_no

SELECT checkpoint_id checkpointId,close_id closeId,run_no runNo,owner_code ownerCode,source_version sourceVersion, source_sequence sourceSequence,source_status sourceStatus,content_sha256 contentSha256,created_at createdAt FROM ops_daily_close_checkpoint WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId} ORDER BY run_no,owner_code

SELECT preflight_id preflightId,close_id closeId,run_no runNo,check_code checkCode,owner_code ownerCode, required_flag required,external_flag external,status,evidence_sha256 evidenceSha256, masked_message maskedMessage,checked_at checkedAt FROM ops_daily_close_preflight WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId} ORDER BY run_no,check_code

SELECT difference_id differenceId,close_id closeId,difference_type type,state,expected_sha256 expectedSha256, actual_sha256 actualSha256,detail_sha256 detailSha256,detected_at detectedAt FROM ops_daily_close_difference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId} ORDER BY detected_at,difference_id

SELECT approval_id approvalId,close_id closeId,approver_user_id approverUserId,reason_sha256 reasonSha256,approved_at approvedAt FROM ops_daily_close_approval WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId} ORDER BY approved_at

SELECT signature_id signatureId,close_id closeId,signatory_user_id signatoryUserId,snapshot_sha256 snapshotSha256, manifest_sha256 manifestSha256,signature_sha256 signatureSha256,signed_at signedAt FROM ops_daily_close_signature WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND close_id=#{closeId} ORDER BY signed_at
